Chapter 635: Chapter 47: 'Funding The Enemy'? (5200 Words, Please Subscribe)

Chapter 635: Chapter 47: ‘Funding the Enemy’? (5200 words, please subscribe)

As this statement was made-

the many Ninth Rank powerhouses present slightly relaxed.

Although there were only a few hundred Ninth Rank powerhouses gathered here-

in reality-

thousands of Ninth Rank powerhouses who were being hunted by human civilization in the Xuanhuang Secret Realm were present, not to mention nearly tens of thousands.

The Ninth Ranks from a few of the Peak Clans’ Alliance, who entered the Secret Realm, accounted for the majority-

...

and the rest were some loners bearing grudges against human civilization.

Thousands, nearly tens of thousands of Ninth Rank powerhouses, could survive in part even if fleeing from the pursuit of Tier 10 powerhouses, let alone facing the Galactic Star Lord?

In the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, the environment is special, suppressing many spatial techniques, rendering teleportation impossible.

Previously, a human evolutionist, Xilan, who had merely created tens of thousands of Spatial Layers, was able to persist for three years, even under the special Ninth Rank Hunyi, who created over thirty million Spatial Layers.

This was very telling.

Indeed, Xilan’s Evolution Path was unique, especially skilled in fleeing danger.

But now, were the many Ninth Rank powerhouses present any less competent? The Supreme Evolution Path? Which of the Peak Clans didn’t possess the Supreme Evolution Path?

“Everyone, the Galactic Star Lord might indeed be unbeatable, but it doesn’t mean we have to let them slaughter us,” said one of the Ninth Rank Insect Race members as they stood up: “Our clan has paid a price to invite the Son of the Tree Realm into the Xuanhuang Secret Realm to contend against that Galactic Star Lord.”

“Our clan has also paid a price to invite the Dragon Scale King into the Xuanhuang Secret Realm to contend against the Galactic Star Lord.”

“Our clan has also paid…”

…

Several Ninth Rank powerhouses from the Peak Clans opened their mouths in succession.

The content they announced excited the many Ninth Rank powerhouses present.

The Son of the Tree Realm, from the mysterious Cosmic Secret Realm, ‘Tree Realm’.

This Cosmic Secret Realm houses a dominion-holder, the Mother of the Tree Realm.

The Mother of the Tree Realm is a rare special entity, an Eleventh Rank Peak existence; the entire Tree Realm is, in the strictest sense, her body.

The Mother of the Tree Realm has an offspring, known as the Son of the Tree Realm; in the vast universe, such special entities are unique to them alone.

Therefore, whether it is the Mother or the Son of the Tree Realm, both are incredibly powerful; their talents are terrifyingly boundless.

The Mother of the Tree Realm presides over the Tree Realm, and even the Supreme Beings are reluctant to attack, mainly because it is pointless.

With the Mother of the Tree Realm’s strength, even if she isn’t a match for a Supreme Being, she still has some means of resistance, at least she has the ability to cause the collapse of the Tree Realm in front of a Supreme Being.

Thus, even if a Supreme Being attacks the Mother of the Tree Realm, they wouldn’t gain any benefits.

Additionally, since the Mother of the Tree Realm voluntarily surrendered to the Insect Race, willing to offer a pound of Tree Realm Essence every ten thousand years, she has been able to survive to this day.

As for the Son of the Tree Realm, currently at Ninth Rank, being such a special entity with a tremendous lifespan, the Son has been at Ninth Rank for at least tens of millions of years.

Therefore, under normal circumstances, the major clusters in the universe wouldn’t consider such a special entity within the range of Ninth Rank, because they aren’t normal Ninth Rank beings.

As for the Dragon Scale King, he is a similar existence to the Son of the Tree Realm.

“The Mother of the Tree Realm?”

“And the Dragon Scale King?”

“These are legendary Ninth Rank beings, not within the normal range of Ninth Rank life forms.”

A few Ninth Rank powerhouses whispered among themselves, their confidence greatly increasing.

No matter if it’s the Mother of the Tree Realm, the Dragon Scale King, or others, their lifespans are frighteningly long; the lifespan of a normal Ninth Rank being might not even compare to a few seclusions they take.

Therefore, if they are included within the normal range of Ninth Rank beings, it would be somewhat unfair to other Ninth Rank beings.

“With such reinforcements, what threat is the Galactic Star Lord?” the Ninth Rank Insect Race looked around at the many powerhouses, emitting a profound mental fluctuation.

He and several of the other Peak Clan powerhouses exchanged glances.

This time, the clans paid such a price partly to not emerge empty-handed from their venture into the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, and partly to preserve their Avatars.

The Doppelganger Skill, though a semi-public Secret Technique among the major clans, the death of an Avatar and its reformation demanded a considerable price.

If so many Ninth Rank powerhouses were to fall in the Xuanhuang Secret Realm at once, even if they were only Avatars, it would substantially impact the major clans.

Finally-

it was a few of the Peak Clans wanting to probe the true strength of the Galactic Star Lord.

Previously, when the Galactic Star Lord killed Hunyi, it was an instant kill; other than learning that the Galactic Star Lord was powerful and that he had created at least hundreds of millions of Spatial Layers-

nothing else was known.

This time, inviting so many legendary Ninth Ranks to participate was intended to ascertain the limits of the Galactic Star Lord.

Perhaps the Supreme Beings cared little for the Galactic Star Lord, but those beneath them, the Tier 10 and Eleventh Rank powerhouses, were very concerned.

Because possibly, in a distant future, they might face the Galactic Star Lord in battle on the Large Alien Battlefield.

Since they were inevitably going to fight against the Galactic Star Lord, naturally, they wanted to gather as much intelligence about him as possible.

…

In the Xuanhuang Secret Realm-

in an outer region-

within a spacious canyon-

thousands of Ninth Rank Different Species had been driven here.

And outside, several hundred human civilization Evolvers had set up a blockade.

Several hundred Ninth Rank powerhouses blocking thousands, even tens of thousands, of Ninth Rank powerhouses?

It seemed like a tall tale; there was no significant difference in individual strength between the two sides, and the blockading side was ten times fewer in number than the blockaded.

But this was the reality.

Due to the deterrence of the Galactic Star Lord.
